_comment: Mutation testing (Thoughtworks Radar Vol. 35, blip 2, Adopt). Proves the extension assertions actually bite. First pass is scoped to the non-TUI modules so a run finishes in minutes; `command` runs the same `npm test` the CI job runs. timeoutMS is measured, not guessed: the whole suite runs in 1.7s on a 4-core host and about 8s on the runner, and stryker adds 1.5x the dry-run time on top of timeoutMS, so 15000 still gives a single mutant about 29s on CI before it is called hung. At the old 60000 a hang cost a full minute: 13 timeouts on PR #106 were 13 minutes of the 25 a job had.
